messages:
sofia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can we get a concise summary of release cadence, oncall expectations, quality gates, and which incidents count as SLA-impacting?

kevin: Summary: regular releases = every other Tuesday deploy with a 48h canary. Production release = any change touching serving runtime or routing. Hotfixes allowed outside cadence for emergencies but require a postmortem.

ajay: Oncall basics: primary rotates weekly and owns immediate mitigation; secondary handles escalation and post-incident tasks. Post a short status into #eng-oncall at shift start. PagerDuty: >3 pages in 30m escalates to off-shift lead.

mira: Quality gates: CI green, integration tests on staging pass (staging mirrors Dedicated sizing), and no perf regression >5% on p95/p99 for affected routes. User-visible changes need PM + ML + eng lead signoff.

caleb: Is there a short canary checklist we can share with PMs?

kevin: TL;DR checklist: health checks stable, throughput within 10% of baseline, smoke prompt-set shows no quality regression, and error budget burn within thresholds. If any fail, rollback and investigate.

sofia: Thanks — can someone drop a one-paragraph we can reference in product decks?

mira: I'll draft a PM-facing paragraph and add it to the Release Playbook.

release-bot: Canary for deploy 2026-03-12-42: 4/4 smoke tests passed, p95 latency within baseline.

caleb: :thumbsup: Thanks all.
